description:
Presented in excellent condition throughout, this spacious three/four-bedroom semi-detached family home enjoys a peaceful position within a quiet, low-density development close to Mullingar Regional Hospital, the town centre and the N4 motorway. Offering bright accommodation, generous outdoor space and a superb location, this attractive home is ideal for families, first-time buyers or those seeking convenient access to local amenities and commuter routes.
The accommodation comprises of an entrance hall with under-stairs storage, decorative coving and quality flooring throughout. To the front of the property, the spacious sitting room is filled with natural light from a large bay window and features a solid fuel fireplace. A second reception room offers excellent flexibility as an additional family room, home office or fourth bedroom. To the rear, the open-plan kitchen and dining area is fitted with an extensive range of wall and floor units, integrated cooking appliances and direct access to the rear garden through sliding patio doors. A separate utility room provides further storage, while a fully tiled ground floor wet room adds practicality and convenience.
Upstairs, there are three generously proportioned bedrooms, all with built-in wardrobes, with the primary bedroom coming en-suite. A well-appointed family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.
Externally, the property occupies a desirable corner site with beautifully maintained lawns to the front and rear. The sunny rear garden features a paved patio area, while a gated side entrance provides easy access. Ample off-street parking is available to the front, and the property enjoys an attractive setting with green areas to the side and rear.
Ideally located within walking distance of St. Finian's College, Mullingar Regional Hospital and a host of local amenities, this superb home also enjoys easy access to Mullingar town centre, the N4 motorway and nearby Lough Owel.
This impressive family home is ready for immediate occupation. Early viewing is highly recommended.
